outcome: Trends in the use of vacuum and forceps
cohort: Women who gave birth during the study period (July 1, 2011, to June 30, 2016) at the study facility
finding: The rate of operative vaginal delivery declined over the 5-year study period, while the cesarean section rate increased, with a notable decrease in the use of vacuum and an increase in the use of forceps.
mod_finding: The use of vacuum-assisted delivery decreased while forceps-assisted delivery increased.
